meta.title: DeepSeek chat
meta.description: A focused DeepSeek chat panel in the main area, opened from the DeepSeek chat entry in the left sidebar. Set your API key, model, and thinking strength, then chat with streaming replies and Markdown. A web-search toggle answers with numbered sources, the microphone turns speech into text, each answer can be read aloud, and OCR turns a PDF, Word, PowerPoint, or image into draft text. Conversations and settings stay in this browser's localStorage and are sent only to your configured API base URL.
